notes: The author's flagship ARIMAX model: log_Precipitation crosscorr against SpecificHumidity/RelativeHumidity/Temperature with seasonal lag=12 terms, IDENTIFY/ESTIMATE/FORECAST/OUTLIER statements unmodified. LIBNAME-backed dataset substituted with a 60-row inline datalines slice (Jan 2000-Dec 2004, five years so the seasonal lag=12 terms have enough history). ODS Graphics turned off (SVG rendering on this fitted model separately errors regardless of PLOTS= scope -- filed as a Jenner bug, not something this bundle depends on). ESTIMATE's OUTSTAT= option dropped (Jenner's ESTIMATE-statement parser doesn't accept it yet, also filed) while OUTEST=/OUTMODEL= are kept since those parse and run. expected.json pins log lines and output substrings rather than exact byte-for-byte output because the OUTLIER statement's borderline Z-score entries have mild run-to-run nondeterminism in the ARIMA ML fit; the four clearly-significant outliers and all AIC/BIC/model-summary lines are stable across repeated runs and are what's pinned.
